identification.description: A woody shrub or small tree of the Premna group, with simple opposite leaves and small flowers borne in terminal or axillary clusters.
identification.whole_plant: Woody shrub or small tree with branched habit.
identification.root: Medicinal root is the principal useful part recorded in this project; detailed field characters require specimen-level verification.
identification.stem: Woody, branched stem; bark grey-brown to brown on mature portions.
identification.leaf: Simple, opposite leaves; shape and surface characters should be confirmed against an authenticated botanical specimen.
identification.flower: Small flowers occurring in clustered inflorescences; detailed colour and floral characters should be checked against a pharmacognostic/botanical reference.
identification.fruit: Small drupe-like fruit; detailed maturity and colour characters require specimen-level verification.
identification.seed: Seed enclosed within the fruit; detailed diagnostic microscopy is not yet recorded.
identification.bark: Mature woody bark; detailed macroscopic and microscopic characters require pharmacopoeial verification.
